invariants.assertion: A success notification requires the canonical verified payment event, matching attempt, webhook and balanced success journal.
A succeeded refund notice requires matching refund history and completion ledger evidence.
Withdrawal notices require a matching canonical wallet and owner; paid status also requires completion time and payout journal.
Earning notices require a matching owner wallet and accrual journal; release or reversal requires its corresponding journal and timestamp.
Status notices perform no financial mutation and explicitly state that a notice is not a bank settlement receipt.

externalAcceptance: Finance, bank and Paystack merchant approval and a separately scoped capped test are still required.
